quest.title: When Flowers Bloom
quest.description: Vardan and Gurgen's Sumeru Rose seems to be blooming...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Perfect timing. We're all set!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's got you so excited?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be that the roses are about to bloom?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Yes, hahaha! We couldn't have done this without you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: The rose hasn't reached full bloom yet, but you can see its extraordinary vitality from its appearance!

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: If you're interested, Traveler, come observe more closely.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: It might just bloom right before your eyes, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I wouldn't miss that for the world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: R—Really? Right now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon's getting excited too!

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Come, come, lean closer so you can see all the details clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You observe the rose bud with the herb growers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing's happening...

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: Oh well... Maybe it was just feeling shy in front of you...

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: But no worries. According to what we know of the rose's life cycle, you should see it blooming by tomorrow at the latest.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Well then, please visit again tomorrow, Traveler!

choices.text: I can barely feel my legs anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, you couldn't have come at a better time. The rose is finally in full bloom!

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, it is the best growing rose I've ever seen.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Please accept these as a token of my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we're really happy that the rose bloomed, too!

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Phew... We can finally deliver the roses to Bimarstan on time.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: I do hope that the roses will be of help to them...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, you couldn't have come at a better time. The rose is finally in full bloom!

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, it is the best growing rose I've ever seen.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: The doctors at Bimarstan will be amazed, too!

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: No time better than now. Let me move this flower...

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Wait, what was that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Something is stirring in the field...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! A Whopperflower! Why is it even here!?

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Oh no! The field! It's ruining the field!

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: One of our roses, the most important of our herbs, turned into a monster and ran away!

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: You mean that the Whopperflower was responsible for the rose's slow growth?

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: Is that so? Then the fertilizer used on it was a waste. And it consumed double the amount of water.

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: Have we just been taking care of this Whopperflower all this time!?

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Darn! How did it even disguise itself amongst the flowers? We never even noticed it!

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: We're in serious trouble now. Our field is totally destroyed as well...

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: We'll have to explain this to Bimarstan and plant new roses...

choices.text: It was likely there from the beginning...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Please visit again tomorrow, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Please, witness its blooming with us!
